title: Grateful Dead Live at Frost Amphitheatre on 1982-10-10
source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC24 > AIFF > Final Cut > AIFF tracking via Audacity > FLAC24 via xACT)

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear matrix recording captures a monster ’82 show with standout China Cat > Rider, Playin’ in the Band, Crazy Fingers and a Mick Jagger‑style Satisfaction.
ai_review.review: The upgraded matrix mix delivers astonishing clarity – listeners describe it as “crystal clear” and perfect for headphones. Musically the concert is an ’82 high‑water mark with a tight first set, a monster second set that rolls through Playin’ > Crazy Fingers > Touch, and a double encore featuring Satisfaction and Baby Blue, all performed with obvious joy and energy.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviews rate the show 5 stars, praising both performance and recording; the show is described as a monster set with high energy, and the matrix source is lauded as crystal‑clear, justifying an almost perfect rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers call it crystal clear, warm, and headphone gold; the mix restores sparkle to a soundboard that lacked it, with excellent room feel and no noted drop‑outs or distortion.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Solid, upbeat first set followed by a monster second set that builds into an ecstatic double encore; transitions are tight and the overall pacing keeps the momentum high.

band_member_comments.Bob: Bob’s Mick Jagger‑style vocal on Satisfaction is highlighted as a fun, cheesy moment.
